title: Home Purchase Financing — Program Entry Requirements by Home-Only Loan Program
content:
**Hearthstone Home Finance — Underwriting Guideline Schedule U-1**

Each Home Purchase Financing program has an entry gate that the home and the applicant must both meet, and its own limits on the down payment, the amount financed and the debt-to-income ratio. A program may be used only where every column of its row is met.

## Entry gate by program

| Program | Minimum credit score | Home condition accepted | Maximum home age (years) | Section types accepted |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Home-Only Loan 7-Year Fixed | 580 | new or pre-owned | 30 | single-section or multi-section |
| Home-Only Loan 10-Year Fixed | 600 | new or pre-owned | 25 | single-section or multi-section |
| Home-Only Loan 15-Year Fixed | 620 | new or pre-owned | 15 | single-section or multi-section |
| Home-Only Loan 20-Year Fixed | 640 | new or pre-owned | 10 | single-section or multi-section |
| Home-Only Loan 23-Year Fixed | 660 | new or pre-owned | 5 | multi-section only |
| Home-Only Loan 25-Year Fixed | 680 | new only | 1 | multi-section only |

Home age is the application year less the model year of the home.

## Down payment, amount financed and debt-to-income limits

| Program | Minimum down payment (% of purchase price) | Minimum amount financed (USD) | Maximum amount financed, financed fees included (USD) | Maximum debt-to-income ratio (%) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Home-Only Loan 7-Year Fixed | 10.0 | 5000.00 | 35000.00 | 43.0 |
| Home-Only Loan 10-Year Fixed | 10.0 | 10000.00 | 60000.00 | 43.0 |
| Home-Only Loan 15-Year Fixed | 7.5 | 20000.00 | 95000.00 | 45.0 |
| Home-Only Loan 20-Year Fixed | 5.0 | 35000.00 | 140000.00 | 45.0 |
| Home-Only Loan 23-Year Fixed | 5.0 | 50000.00 | 175000.00 | 45.0 |
| Home-Only Loan 25-Year Fixed | 5.0 | 75000.00 | 225000.00 | 45.0 |

The debt-to-income ratio is total monthly debt payments — the new installment, the site rent and the escrow included — as a percentage of gross monthly income.

## Reading the schedule

- **Credit score and home age are floors and ceilings.** A 620 score meets the Home-Only Loan 15-Year Fixed gate; a 619 score does not. A home whose age is exactly 15 years is within the 15-year program's maximum; a home aged 16 years is not.
- **Section type.** A single-section home cannot enter the Home-Only Loan 23-Year Fixed or the Home-Only Loan 25-Year Fixed program, whatever its age or the applicant's score.
- **Home condition.** Only the Home-Only Loan 25-Year Fixed program is closed to pre-owned homes.

*Hypothetical illustration:* a multi-section home with model year 2022 applied for in 2026 is 4 years old. On age and section type alone it fits the 23-Year program (maximum 5) but not the 25-Year program (maximum 1); the applicant's score and the amount and ratio limits must also be met for the program chosen.
